CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.asistencia_resumen(p_desde date, p_hasta date)
 RETURNS TABLE(usuario_id uuid, usuario_nombre text, fecha date, semana character, sucursal_id uuid, entrada_esperada time without time zone, salida_esperada time without time zone, almuerzo_ini time without time zone, almuerzo_fin time without time zone, entrada_at timestamp with time zone, almuerzo_ini_at timestamp with time zone, almuerzo_fin_at timestamp with time zone, salida_at timestamp with time zone, minutos_tarde integer, horas_trabajadas numeric, estado text, notas text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    with dias as (select d::date as fecha from generate_series(p_desde, least(p_hasta, p_desde + 92), interval '1 day') d),
    gente as (
        select u.id, u.nombre from usuarios u
        where u.activo is not false and (exists (select 1 from horarios_personal h where h.usuario_id = u.id)
                                         or exists (select 1 from asistencias a where a.usuario_id = u.id and a.fecha between p_desde and p_hasta))
    ),
    base as (
        select g.id, g.nombre, d.fecha, horario_semana(g.id, d.fecha) as semana
        from gente g cross join dias d
    )
    select b.id, b.nombre, b.fecha, b.semana, coalesce(h.sucursal_id, hp.sucursal_id, a.sucursal_id),
           h.entrada, h.salida, h.almuerzo_ini, h.almuerzo_fin,
           a.entrada_at, a.almuerzo_ini_at, a.almuerzo_fin_at, a.salida_at,
           case when h.entrada is not null and a.entrada_at is not null
                then greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from ((a.entrada_at at time zone 'America/Caracas')::time - h.entrada)) / 60)::int
                                 - coalesce(hp.tolerancia_min, 10))::int end as minutos_tarde,
           case when a.entrada_at is not null and a.salida_at is not null
                then round((extract(epoch from (a.salida_at - a.entrada_at))
                            - coalesce(extract(epoch from (a.almuerzo_fin_at - a.almuerzo_ini_at)), 0)) / 3600.0, 2) end as horas_trabajadas,
           case when a.entrada_at is not null and a.salida_at is null and b.fecha < (now() at time zone 'America/Caracas')::date then 'sin_salida'
                when a.entrada_at is not null then 'asistio'
                when h.entrada is null then 'libre'
                when b.fecha > (now() at time zone 'America/Caracas')::date then 'pendiente'
                when b.fecha = (now() at time zone 'America/Caracas')::date and (now() at time zone 'America/Caracas')::time < h.entrada then 'pendiente'
                else 'ausente' end as estado,
           a.notas
    from base b
    left join horario_personas hp on hp.usuario_id = b.id
    left join horarios_personal h on h.usuario_id = b.id and h.semana = b.semana and h.dia = extract(dow from b.fecha)::int
    left join asistencias a on a.usuario_id = b.id and a.fecha = b.fecha
    order by b.fecha desc, b.nombre
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.asistente_estado()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare c record; o jsonb; r jsonb;
begin
    select * into c from configuracion limit 1;
    o := coalesce(c.opciones, '{}'::jsonb);
    r := jsonb_build_object(
        'fiscal', c.rif is not null and rif_valido(c.rif) and c.nombre_negocio is not null and coalesce(c.direccion, '') <> '',
        'logo', coalesce(o ->> 'logo', '') <> '',
        'rubro', coalesce(c.rubro, '') <> '' and (coalesce((o ->> 'rubro_confirmado')::boolean, false) or current_schema() = 'public'),
        'sucursales', (select count(*) from sucursales),
        'tasa', coalesce(c.tasa_bcv_manual, 0) > 0,
        'usuarios', (select count(*) from usuarios where activo is not false),
        'productos', (select count(*) from productos where activo is not false),
        'con_stock', (select count(*) from productos where coalesce(stock, 0) > 0) + coalesce((select count(*) from sucursal_stock where stock > 0), 0),
        'clientes', (select count(*) from clientes),
        'clientes_saldo', (select count(*) from clientes where coalesce(saldo_pendiente, 0) > 0),
        'proveedores', (select count(*) from proveedores),
        'cxp', case when to_regclass('compras_proveedores') is null then 0 else (select count(*) from compras_proveedores) end,
        'ventas', (select count(*) from ventas),
        'opciones', o - 'logo'
    );
    return r;
end;
$function$
;

 SECURITY DEFINER

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(t order by t.vence), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select
      id as venta_id,
      numero,
      cliente_nombre,
      cliente_rif,
      total_usd,
      monto_abonado,
      (created_at::date + coalesce(dias_credito, 30)) as vence,
      greatest(coalesce(total_usd, 0) - coalesce(monto_abonado, 0), 0) as saldo,
      sucursal_nombre
    from ventas
    where metodo_pago = 'credito'
      and estado = 'completada'
      and greatest(coalesce(total_usd, 0) - coalesce(monto_abonado, 0), 0) > 0.005
      and (created_at::date + coalesce(dias_credito, 30)) <= current_date + coalesce(p_dias, 3)
      and (ultimo_aviso is null or ultimo_aviso < current_date - 2)
  ) t;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.inventario_analisis(p_sucursal_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_dias integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    with suc as (select case when p_sucursal_id is null or p_sucursal_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' then null else p_sucursal_id end as id),
    vend as (
        select d.producto_codigo, sum(d.cantidad) as cant, sum(d.total) as monto, max(v.created_at) as ultima
        from detalle_venta d join ventas v on v.id = d.venta_id, suc
        where v.estado = 'completada' and v.created_at >= now() - make_interval(days => greatest(coalesce(p_dias, 30), 1))
          and ((suc.id is null and (v.sucursal_id is null or v.sucursal_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')) or v.sucursal_id = suc.id)
        group by d.producto_codigo),
    ultima as (
        select d.producto_codigo, max(v.created_at) as ultima
        from detalle_venta d join ventas v on v.id = d.venta_id
        where v.estado = 'completada' group by d.producto_codigo),
    prom as (
        select distinct on (producto_codigo) producto_codigo, saldo_costo_promedio
        from kardex_movimientos, suc
        where (suc.id is null and sucursal_id is null) or sucursal_id = suc.id
        order by producto_codigo, created_at desc)
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'codigo', p.codigo, 'nombre', p.descripcion, 'categoria', p.categoria, 'marca', p.marca, 'unidad', p.unidad,
        'servicio', coalesce(p.tipo_producto, 'fisico') = 'servicio',
        'stock', case when suc.id is null then coalesce(p.stock, 0) else coalesce(ss.stock, 0) end,
        'costo', coalesce(nullif(ss.costo, 0), p.costo, 0),
        'costo_promedio', coalesce(nullif(pr.saldo_costo_promedio, 0), nullif(ss.costo, 0), p.costo, 0),
        'precio', coalesce(p.precio, 0),
        'minimo', coalesce(p.stock_minimo, 0), 'maximo', p.stock_maximo,
        'vendido', coalesce(vd.cant, 0), 'ingreso', coalesce(vd.monto, 0),
        'ultima_venta', ul.ultima,
        'vencimiento', nullif(p.atributos ->> 'vencimiento', ''),
        'lote', nullif(p.atributos ->> 'lote', ''),
        'ubicacion', nullif(p.atributos ->> 'ubicacion', ''),
        'proveedores', p.proveedores
    )), '[]'::jsonb)
    from productos p cross join suc
    left join sucursal_stock ss on ss.sucursal_id = suc.id and ss.producto_codigo = p.codigo
    left join vend vd on vd.producto_codigo = p.codigo
    left join ultima ul on ul.producto_codigo = p.codigo
    left join prom pr on pr.producto_codigo = p.codigo
    where coalesce(p.activo, true)
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.iva_normalizar(p text)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
    select case
        when p is null or trim(p) = '' then null
        when lower(trim(p)) in ('exento', 'e', 'ex', 'no', 'iva exento', '0', '0%') then 0
        when regexp_replace(p, '[^0-9.,]', '', 'g') = '' then null
        else least(100, greatest(0, replace(regexp_replace(p, '[^0-9.,]', '', 'g'), ',', '.')::numeric
                     * case when replace(regexp_replace(p, '[^0-9.,]', '', 'g'), ',', '.')::numeric < 1 then 100 else 1 end))
    end;
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.libro_ventas(p_desde date, p_hasta date, p_sucursal_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    with v as (
        select v.*, coalesce(nullif(v.tasa_bcv, 0), case when v.total_usd > 0 then v.total_bs / v.total_usd else 0 end) as ts
        from ventas v
        where v.created_at >= p_desde and v.created_at < p_hasta + 1 and v.estado in ('completada', 'anulada', 'devuelta')
          and (p_sucursal_id is null or v.sucursal_id = p_sucursal_id
               or (p_sucursal_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' and v.sucursal_id is null))),
    l as (
        select d.venta_id, coalesce(p.iva_tasa, 16) as tasa, sum(d.total) as monto
        from detalle_venta d join v on v.id = d.venta_id left join productos p on p.codigo = d.producto_codigo
        group by d.venta_id, coalesce(p.iva_tasa, 16)),
    lt as (select venta_id, sum(monto) as monto from l group by venta_id)
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x->>'fecha', x->>'numero'), '[]'::jsonb) from (
        select jsonb_build_object(
            'tipo', 'FACT', 'fecha', v.created_at, 'numero', v.numero, 'numero_control', v.numero_control, 'numero_fiscal', v.numero_fiscal, 'serial_fiscal', v.serial_fiscal,
            'cliente_rif', v.cliente_rif, 'cliente_nombre', v.cliente_nombre, 'estado', v.estado, 'tasa', v.ts,
            'total_bs', round(coalesce(v.total_bs, v.total_usd * v.ts), 2),
            'incluido', abs(coalesce(lt.monto, 0) - coalesce(v.total_usd, 0)) < 0.02,
            'exento_bs', round(coalesce((select sum(monto) from l where l.venta_id = v.id and l.tasa = 0), 0) * v.ts, 2),
            'base16_bs', round(coalesce((select sum(case when abs(coalesce(lt.monto, 0) - coalesce(v.total_usd, 0)) < 0.02 then monto / 1.16 else monto end) from l where l.venta_id = v.id and l.tasa = 16), 0) * v.ts, 2),
            'base8_bs', round(coalesce((select sum(case when abs(coalesce(lt.monto, 0) - coalesce(v.total_usd, 0)) < 0.02 then monto / 1.08 else monto end) from l where l.venta_id = v.id and l.tasa = 8), 0) * v.ts, 2),
            'iva_bs', round(coalesce(v.iva, 0) * v.ts, 2),
            'igtf_bs', coalesce(v.igtf_bs, 0)
        ) as x
        from v left join lt on lt.venta_id = v.id
        union all
        select jsonb_build_object(
            'tipo', 'N/C', 'fecha', n.created_at, 'numero', n.numero, 'numero_control', to_jsonb(n) ->> 'numero_control', 'factura_afectada', n.venta_numero,
            'cliente_rif', n.cliente_rif, 'cliente_nombre', n.cliente_nombre, 'estado', 'nota_credito',
            'total_bs', -round(n.total_bs, 2), 'exento_bs', 0, 'base16_bs', -round(n.total_bs / 1.16, 2), 'base8_bs', 0,
            'iva_bs', -round(n.total_bs - n.total_bs / 1.16, 2), 'igtf_bs', 0)
        from notas_credito n
        where n.created_at >= p_desde and n.created_at < p_hasta + 1
          and (p_sucursal_id is null or n.sucursal_id = p_sucursal_id
               or (p_sucursal_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' and n.sucursal_id is null))
        union all
        select jsonb_build_object(
            'tipo', 'N/D', 'fecha', d.fecha, 'numero', d.numero, 'numero_control', d.numero_control, 'factura_afectada', d.factura_numero,
            'cliente_rif', d.cliente_rif, 'cliente_nombre', d.cliente_nombre, 'estado', d.estado,
            'total_bs', case when d.estado = 'anulada' then 0 else round(d.total_bs, 2) end,
            'exento_bs', case when d.estado = 'anulada' or d.iva_pct <> 0 then 0 else round(d.subtotal_usd * d.tasa_bcv, 2) end,
            'base16_bs', case when d.estado = 'anulada' or d.iva_pct <> 16 then 0 else round(d.subtotal_usd * d.tasa_bcv, 2) end,
            'base8_bs', case when d.estado = 'anulada' or d.iva_pct <> 8 then 0 else round(d.subtotal_usd * d.tasa_bcv, 2) end,
            'iva_bs', case when d.estado = 'anulada' then 0 else round(d.iva_usd * d.tasa_bcv, 2) end, 'igtf_bs', 0)
        from notas_debito d
        where d.fecha >= p_desde and d.fecha < p_hasta + 1
          and (p_sucursal_id is null or d.sucursal_id = p_sucursal_id
               or (p_sucursal_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' and d.sucursal_id is null))
    ) q
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.producto_guardar(p_codigo text, p_descripcion text, p_categoria text DEFAULT ''::text, p_costo numeric DEFAULT 0, p_precio numeric DEFAULT 0, p_stock numeric DEFAULT 0, p_stock_minimo numeric DEFAULT 5, p_marca text DEFAULT ''::text, p_unidad text DEFAULT 'uds'::text, p_codigos_alternos text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_id uuid;
  v_sucursal_id uuid := 'dd07bd88-ca35-421b-bea9-4807b8ab2681'; -- Casa Matriz
BEGIN
  IF p_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.productos SET
      codigo = p_codigo,
      descripcion = p_descripcion,
      categoria = p_categoria,
      costo = p_costo,
      precio = p_precio,
      stock = p_stock,
      stock_minimo = p_stock_minimo,
      marca = p_marca,
      unidad = p_unidad,
      codigos_alternos = p_codigos_alternos
    WHERE id = p_id
    RETURNING id INTO v_id;
  ELSE
    INSERT INTO public.productos (
      codigo, descripcion, categoria, costo, precio,
      stock, stock_minimo, marca, unidad, codigos_alternos
    ) VALUES (
      p_codigo, p_descripcion, p_categoria, p_costo, p_precio,
      p_stock, p_stock_minimo, p_marca, p_unidad, p_codigos_alternos
    ) RETURNING id INTO v_id;
  END IF;

  -- Create/update sucursal_stock for Casa Matriz
  INSERT INTO public.sucursal_stock (sucursal_id, producto_codigo, producto_descripcion, stock, costo, updated_at)
  VALUES (v_sucursal_id, p_codigo, p_descripcion, p_stock, p_costo, now())
  ON CONFLICT (sucursal_id, producto_codigo) DO UPDATE SET
    producto_descripcion = EXCLUDED.producto_descripcion,
    stock = EXCLUDED.stock,
    costo = EXCLUDED.costo,
    updated_at = now();

  RETURN v_id;
END; $function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.top_productos_vendidos(p_sucursal_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(producto_codigo text, descripcion text, cantidad numeric, stock numeric, precio numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    select
        d.producto_codigo,
        coalesce((select pr.descripcion from productos pr where pr.codigo = d.producto_codigo limit 1), d.descripcion) as descripcion,
        sum(d.cantidad) as cantidad,
        coalesce((select pr.stock from productos pr where pr.codigo = d.producto_codigo limit 1), 0) as stock,
        coalesce((select pr.precio from productos pr where pr.codigo = d.producto_codigo limit 1), 0) as precio
    from detalle_venta d
    join ventas v on v.id = d.venta_id
    where v.estado is distinct from 'anulada'
      and (p_sucursal_id is null or v.sucursal_id = p_sucursal_id)
    group by d.producto_codigo, d.descripcion

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.unidad_normalizar(p text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
    select case
        when p is null or trim(p) = '' then 'uds'
        when lower(trim(p)) in ('mt', 'm', 'mts', 'metro', 'metros', 'mtr', 'ml') then 'mt'
        when lower(trim(p)) in ('kg', 'kgs', 'kilo', 'kilos', 'kilogramo', 'kilogramos') then 'kg'
        else 'uds'
    end;
$function$
;
